post: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a production-ready raster BACKPLATE for one destructible social-media POST in the Japanese anime shooting game Refrain. Landscape exactly 13:8 aspect, intended runtime size 520x320 pixels. Draw a straight-on flat rectangular social post panel filling the entire image, NO perspective, NO tilt, no external background or margins, outer corners almost square (radius about 4px at runtime). A sophisticated restrained smoked-black glass / graphite display surface with exquisitely thin pearl-silver and ice-cyan machined edges, subtly chipped beveled glass edges but NOT already cracked. Thin double edge layers at the left and right, subtle frosted etched grain and fine interference only at the outer 12 pixels, most of the face smooth and very dark, legible as solid charcoal. Fine header divider across x5%-95% at y26%, finer footer divider at y84%. Reserve header area y5%-23% blank for live avatar at x8%, name at x16% and status aligned right. Reserve the ENTIRE body x5%-95%, y32%-77% perfectly clean empty dark surface for three lines of Japanese dialogue. Footer y87%-95% also mostly clear for live metadata. This should feel like an expensive fragile pane containing an actual social-media post, manga game cinematic UI, not a generic futuristic control console. Specific crafted design: faint cool-white thin rails along the top left and lower right edge, two tiny asymmetric inset notches in the outer border, ghosted second glass lamination visible at the very edge. Absolutely NO text, no glyphs, no fake Japanese, no numbers, no logo, no icon or avatar, no buttons, no cracks, no particles, no orbs, no large glow, no cables or machinery. Never decorate the central content region. Restrained, sharp, beautifully finished anime game UI raster illustration.
